title: 恐龙会照顾宝宝吗
subtitle: 有的守着窝，有的下完就走
character: wearing a mustard yellow t-shirt, green shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible layered strokes and soft grain, warm mustard, leaf green and soft brown

pages.zh:
博物馆里摆着一窝蛋，
十几个挨在一起，
围成一个圈。
爸爸说这是恐龙的窝。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy in a museum beside a mounted nest of fossil eggs, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, his mouth open in surprise.

pages.zh:
窝是一个泥坑，
边上堆起一圈土。
有澡盆那么大，
蛋就一个挨一个
一个个竖在坑里。

蛋并不大，
和柚子差不多。
那么大的恐龙，
下出来的蛋
只有这么一点。

壳碎了以后，
小恐龙爬出来，
只有猫那么大，
腿软软的，
站都站不稳。
pages.scene: Several newly hatched dinosaurs with scaly skin, beaked snouts and stubby tails sitting in a bowl-shaped mud nest on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
看它们的腿骨，
两头还软软的，
没有长结实。
这样的腿脚
走不了远路。

可它们的小牙
已经磨平了一点。
牙被磨平，
就是吃过东西。
没出窝也有得吃。

窝里还留着
嚼碎的叶子。
小恐龙嚼不动，
是大恐龙嚼好了，
叼回来喂它们。
pages.scene: One adult duck-billed dinosaur lowering its head over a bowl-shaped mud nest and dropping chewed leaves to several hatchlings with scaly skin, beaked snouts and stubby tails, on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这样的窝不止一个，
一大片排在一起。
窝和窝隔开的距离，
正好是一只
大恐龙的长度。

另一种恐龙
干脆趴在窝上，
前肢张得开开的，
把整整一圈蛋
都盖在身子底下。
pages.scene: One feathered dinosaur crouching low on top of a ring of oval eggs on a cream background, its arms spread wide out over them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
也有的恐龙
根本不守窝。
找一块暖沙地，
把蛋埋进去，
扭头就走了。
pages.scene: One long-necked dinosaur walking away from a patch of sandy ground where oval eggs lie half buried, on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
不守窝的那种
一次下几十个蛋，
能活几个算几个。
守窝的下得少，
可是一个个看得住。

我数了数那窝蛋，
一共十七个。
真有大恐龙
嚼碎了叶子
回来喂它们吗？
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy leaning over a low glass case of fossil eggs and counting them with one raised finger, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, curious.
